papers.title: Effect of plasma electrolytic polishing on the fatigue performance of additive manufactured Ti-6Al-4V removable partial denture clasps
papers.first_author_affiliation: Clinical associate professor, Department of stomatology, Fujian Provincial Governmental Hospital, Fuzhou, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Minrui Xu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Clinical associate professor, Department of stomatology, Fujian Provincial Governmental Hospital, Fuzhou, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了等离子电解抛光这一后处理工艺对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V疲劳性能的影响，符合L2方向对后处理控制的要求。
llm.why_not_core: The paper is focused on dental clasps, but the effect of post-processing on fatigue is directly applicable to Ti-6Al-4V AM components in general.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究等离子电解抛光对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V可摘局部义齿卡环疲劳性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对激光粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V卡环进行等离子电解抛光处理，并进行疲劳测试。
summary_zh.result: 等离子电解抛光显著提高了卡环的疲劳寿命。
summary_zh.validation: 通过疲劳试验验证了后处理对疲劳性能的改善。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the effect of plasma electrolytic polishing on the fatigue performance of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V removable partial denture clasps.
summary_en.method: Plasma electrolytic polishing was applied to laser powder bed fusion Ti-6Al-4V clasps, and fatigue testing was conducted to evaluate the improvement.
summary_en.result: Plasma electrolytic polishing significantly enhanced the fatigue life of the clasps.
summary_en.validation: Experimental fatigue testing was performed to validate the post-processing effect on fatigue performance.
